evidence_used: Telemetry: 'Razorpay Webhook verify signature failed' on every event
Webhooks return 200 with empty body but order never updated
Merchant created a new webhook for a staging copy last week
fix: Make the live site's webhook secret in plugin settings match the secret on the live webhook in the Razorpay dashboard (staging webhook likely changed it).

evidence_used: hold_stock_minutes=10; order auto-cancelled at 11:22 'time limit reached'
Payment captured 11:27, after cancellation
Cron: 'current status: cancelled, skipping update'
fix: Manually mark order 7731 paid (or refund) and raise Hold Stock to 60+ minutes or disable it.

evidence_used: Telemetry: 'Unknown column rzp_update_order_cron_status' DB error each cron run
Plugin auto-updated 4.5.4 -> 4.5.6 the day before
Webhook queued fine but order never updated
fix: Run the plugin's DB migration (deactivate/reactivate or update to a fixed version) to add the missing column, then reprocess queued webhooks.

evidence_used: All webhook deliveries 403 'Your access to this site has been limited by the site owner'
Wordfence with rate limiting and country blocking active
fix: Allowlist Razorpay webhook IPs / the webhook URL in Wordfence, then mark order 4410 paid or resend the webhook.

evidence_used: payment_action=authorize; payment only authorized, not captured
Telemetry: 'payment state authorized; no capture performed'
Dashboard warns of auto-refund if not captured by 2026-09-28
fix: Capture the payment from the dashboard before the auto-refund deadline and switch payment action back to capture (or capture pre-orders manually).

evidence_used: DISABLE_WP_CRON=true with no system crontab; 214 past-due scheduled actions
Webhooks queued but never processed
fix: Add a server cron hitting wp-cron.php every 5 minutes (or re-enable WP-Cron), then let queued webhooks process.

evidence_used: Every delivery timed out at 5000 ms / 504 Gateway Time-out
Shared host with 1 PHP worker, ~7s TTFB during flash sale
fix: Mark order 88213 paid manually and upgrade hosting/PHP workers or trim plugins so the webhook responds within 5s.

evidence_used: Retry via My Account > Orders created new Razorpay order order_PsF5zT2nBg7KuM
Store meta still holds old order_PsF2cV4mXe1HpJ
Telemetry: 'order_id does not match stored order meta'
fix: Manually mark order 6670 paid with pay_PsF6hY0aQc9LwD, and update the plugin so pay-for-order retries overwrite _razorpay_order_id.

evidence_used: Telemetry: PHP Fatal 'get_status() on bool' in razorpay-webhook.php
HPOS enabled 2026-09-30 on old plugin 4.4.3
payment.authorized webhooks return 500 critical error
fix: Update the Razorpay plugin to an HPOS-compatible version (or turn on HPOS compatibility sync), then mark order 15502 paid.

evidence_used: No webhook URL configured; webhook secret not set
Customer paid in GPay and browser crashed before redirect
fix: Mark order 2981 paid manually and configure a webhook with secret in the Razorpay dashboard and plugin settings.

evidence_used: Webhook status 'disabled' since 2026-10-04 after repeated 502s
502s coincide with the Oct 3-4 hosting migration
No deliveries attempted for this order
fix: Re-enable the webhook in the Razorpay dashboard and reconcile all orders stuck since Oct 4.

evidence_used: Webhook body: Fatal 'Cannot redeclare shopzen_cart_badge()' between child theme and Woo Cart Badges
order.paid returned 200 but with fatal body; payment.authorized 500
Both installed/edited on 2026-10-06
fix: Deactivate Woo Cart Badges or remove the duplicate function from the child theme, then mark order 1177 paid.

evidence_used: Update failed with DB deadlock
Cron still set rzp_update_order_cron_status=1 for the rows
Later cron runs process 0 rows; server cron healthy
fix: Mark order 30447 paid manually and update the plugin so failed updates stay queued for retry.

evidence_used: Webhooks first attempted ~2.5h after capture (11:34 -> 14:02)
Other merchants incl. Shopify affected; status page incident
Order snapshot taken seconds after queueing, cron healthy
fix: No site change needed; confirm order updates on the next cron run and mark paid manually if not.

evidence_used: hold_stock_minutes=15; order cancelled 17:45, payment captured 17:48
Telemetry: order later restored from cancelled at 19:23 (after the 18:40 snapshot)
fix: Order is now restored; verify it shows paid, and raise Hold Stock above UPI collect windows or disable it.

evidence_used: Webhook bodies show Fatal TypeError number_format() in woo-razorpay.php updateOrder despite HTTP 200
PHP upgraded 7.4 -> 8.2 on 2026-10-08
fix: Update the Razorpay plugin to a PHP 8.2-compatible version (and turn display_errors off), then mark order 1903 paid.
